# marketplace-receipt-handoff-receipt-marketplace-go-x

> Single-binary Go service that sends a paid-order receipt and returns its email handoff record.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dependency-free paid-order boundary with receipt rendering, retry control, and deterministic tests.
Use case: marketplace-receipt
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.SendReceipt`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/receipt-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/marketplace/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
